test_title: PYST 39: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4eea20b730cc4d2e5b15345947ea7688e123a5e46fdda26c501c521bd06d8eea.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step 1: The letters in each image is shifting +1 in their positional values in English Alphabetical series and in anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45aadf6e53d955daaf70274e4ab335a60ecea8d7e84093aaeae87fa8a8a4803a.png] 

Step 2: The image in centre is filled and empty alternatively and its sides and vertices are by increasing +1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/304c018c0f21707af947a7b9a19ff917f6da0868489d50c5992c7e4ede6df858.png] 

So,** Image 5** will replace the question mark in the series.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 4'.***
